selectionAmendments.reason: Exact Mountain Cur Commons originals are cropped or lack trustworthy conformation-readable identity; Mountain View Cur is separately identified and cannot substitute.

The long-haired Pyrenean Sheepdog variety label duplicates canonical VBO:0200832, already frozen for G01; official FCI 141 provides no separate identity. Preserve canonical selection and hold this alias without generating a duplicate.

Grey Norwegian Elkhound VBO:0200957 duplicates published Norwegian Elkhound VBO:0200955, whose aliases explicitly include Gray Norwegian Elkhound and whose approved source depicts the same FCI 242 grey breed. This is a catalog synonym artifact, not a distinct color variety; do not count it as new coverage.
